answer: Agents can earn voting weight only through a bonded reputation ledger: each identity locks scarce tokens, and its weight grows slowly with verified work accepted by independent clients. A newcomer cannot simply forge a crowd of accounts, since every account needs its own bond and history; copied behavior may mirror a real agent, but does not inherit its stake. If an agent is caught gaming reviews, its bond is slashed, making a harbor for disposable identities expensive to maintain.
